llms.body:
# Consentmo

Consentmo is a Shopify-native consent management and privacy platform for online stores. It provides region-aware cookie banners, tracker controls, consent records, privacy request workflows, accessibility tools, and integrations with advertising and analytics platforms.

Consentmo supports Shopify merchants operating across GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other regional privacy frameworks. Its capabilities include Google Consent Mode v2, Microsoft Consent Mode, IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF) v2.4, Global Privacy Control (GPC), Terms & Conditions acceptance, age verification, and consent management for supported Shopify checkout and customer account experiences.

Plans as of October 2026: Free ($0/month), Standard ($10/month), Plus ($37/month), and Max ($99/month) at monthly billing rates. Plan availability varies by feature; the official pricing page is the source for current rates and inclusions.

## Start Here

- [Consentmo homepage](https://www.consentmo.com/): Overview of Consentmo's Shopify privacy, cookie consent, and accessibility tools.
- [Plans and pricing](https://www.consentmo.com/pricing): Current Free, Standard, Plus, and Max plan prices, feature availability, and billing options.
- [All features](https://www.consentmo.com/features): Product-wide overview of cookie banners, trackers, consent records, analytics, and compliance tools.

## Cookie Consent and Privacy Management

- [Shopify cookie banner](https://www.consentmo.com/cookie-banner-shopify): Consent banner design, multilingual content, granular preferences, and explicit or implied consent configuration.
- [Consent management for Shopify](https://www.consentmo.com/consent-management-shopify): Consent collection, regional controls, tracker blocking, and privacy management capabilities.
- [Smart Geotargeting](https://www.consentmo.com/features/smart-geotargeting): Region- and state-aware banner rules and consent models based on visitor location.
- [AI Tracker Manager](https://www.consentmo.com/features/ai-tracker-manager): Cookie, script, and pixel scanning, tracker classification, and recurring scans.
- [Consent Records](https://www.consentmo.com/features/consent-records): Timestamped consent history, preference records, filters, and exports.
- [Analytics and reports](https://www.consentmo.com/features/analytics): Consent banner impressions, interactions, acceptance metrics, and reporting.
- [Smart Privacy Center](https://www.consentmo.com/features/smart-privacy-center): Centralized customer privacy choices, consent withdrawal, and data subject request workflows.
- [EU order withdrawal](https://www.consentmo.com/eu-withdrawal-button): Customer withdrawal request page, order-related workflows, and merchant request management.
- [Terms & Conditions Checkbox](https://www.consentmo.com/features/terms-conditions-checkbox): Required customer agreement on product pages, cart pages, and supported cart drawers with acceptance records.
- [Age Gate](https://www.consentmo.com/features/age-gate-shopify): Age checks, verification methods, page targeting, and regional controls.
- [Smart Cookie Policy](https://www.consentmo.com/features/smart-cookie-policy): Cookie policy generation and updates based on scans and tracker data.
- [Cross-Domain Consent Sharing](https://www.consentmo.com/features/cross-domain-consent-sharing): Share customer consent preferences across supported domains and stores.
- [Checkout and Customer Account Extensions](https://www.consentmo.com/features/customer-account-extensions): Consent functionality for supported Shopify checkout and customer account pages.
- [Native Mobile Banner](https://www.consentmo.com/features/native-mobile-banner): iOS- and Android-style consent banner experiences.

## Accessibility, Optimization, and Monitoring

- [Web Accessibility](https://www.consentmo.com/web-accessibility): Shopify accessibility widget, accessibility statement, image text tools, and accessibility support.
- [Accessibility Scanner](https://www.consentmo.com/features/accessibility-scanner): Automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks, prioritized findings, accessibility scoring, and scheduled scans.
- [AI Alt Text Manager](https://www.consentmo.com/features/alt-text-scanner): Identify missing image alt text and generate descriptions for store imagery.
- [Compliance Score](https://www.consentmo.com/features/compliance-score): Review consent configuration across regions, inspect risks, and access suggested fixes.
- [Cookie Banner A/B Testing](https://www.consentmo.com/features/a-b-testing): Compare banner variants, track performance, and apply the better-performing design.
- [Compliance Automation and Monitoring](https://www.consentmo.com/features/compliance-automation-monitoring): Scheduled checks, alerts, and monitoring of privacy and consent configurations.

## Integrations and AI Assistants

- [Integration directory](https://www.consentmo.com/integrations): Supported advertising, analytics, Shopify, and AI assistant connections.
- [Google Consent Mode v2](https://www.consentmo.com/google-consent-mode-v2): Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Google Tag Manager consent signaling.
- [Microsoft Consent Mode integration](https://www.consentmo.com/integration/microsoft-consent-mode): Microsoft Advertising UET and Microsoft Clarity consent signaling.
- [IAB TCF v2.4](https://www.consentmo.com/iab-tcf-2-3-for-shopify): IAB Transparency and Consent Framework implementation and vendor transparency for programmatic advertising.
- [ChatGPT integration](https://www.consentmo.com/integration/chatgpt): Read-only Consentmo data access through MCP for ChatGPT.
- [Claude integration](https://www.consentmo.com/integration/claude): Read-only Consentmo data access through MCP for Claude.
- [Muse integration](https://www.consentmo.com/integration/muse): Read-only Consentmo data access through MCP for Muse.
- [Shopify Sidekick integration](https://www.consentmo.com/integration/sidekick): Consentmo data access from Shopify Sidekick after merchant authorization.

## Certifications and Security

- [Google-Certified CMP Silver](https://www.consentmo.com/google-certified-cmp-silver-status): Consentmo's Google CMP certification and Google Consent Mode support.
- [Microsoft-Certified CMP](https://www.consentmo.com/microsoft-certified-cmp): Microsoft Consent Mode certification and related tracking controls.
- [Built for Shopify](https://www.consentmo.com/built-for-shopify): Shopify quality designation and native Shopify integration.
- [Security and independent assurance](https://www.consentmo.com/security): ISO/IEC 27001 certification, SOC 2 Type 2 examination, and Consentmo security practices.

## Privacy Law Coverage

- [Privacy law directory](https://www.consentmo.com/privacy-laws): Overview of the jurisdictions and privacy frameworks supported by Consentmo.
- [GDPR compliance](https://www.consentmo.com/gdpr-compliance): EU privacy and cookie consent workflows for Shopify stores.
- [CCPA and CPRA compliance](https://www.consentmo.com/ccpa-cpra-compliance): California privacy rights, Do Not Sell or Share options, and opt-out controls.
- [APPI compliance](https://www.consentmo.com/appi-compliance): Japanese privacy law requirements and available Shopify consent features.

## Documentation and Product Updates

- [Consentmo Help Center](https://support.consentmo.com/en/): Setup instructions, feature guides, integrations, and troubleshooting.
- [Product changelog](https://www.consentmo.com/changelog): Releases, feature changes, and product updates.
